# Data & Workspace Requirements Checklist: Yahoo Finance Market Data Integration, Legacy Data Migration & Web Explorer Workspace

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality (completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, and edge-case coverage) across SQLite storage isolation, PostgreSQL migration, FastAPI contracts, and Web Dashboard tabs.
**Created**: 2026-10-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the exact SQLite table schemas (`tickers`, `stock_prices`, `valuation_history`) and primary key constraints documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, data-model.md §1]
- [x] CHK002 Are all three required PostgreSQL migration source tables (`tickers`, `stock_prices`, `valuation_history`) and their target upsert rules specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK003 Are all REST API endpoints under `/api/v1/yahoo` documented with request/response schemas and status codes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, contracts/yahoo-api.md §1]
- [x] CHK004 Are both CLI subcommands (`yahoo-migrate` and `yahoo-sync`) and their arguments explicitly defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004, contracts/yahoo-api.md §2]

## Requirement Clarity & Consistency

- [x] CHK005 Are timeframe resampling rules for `D1`, `W1`, and `MN1` unambiguously defined (`open=first`, `high=max`, `low=min`, `close=last`, `volume=sum`)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, data-model.md §2]
- [x] CHK006 Is the exchange market-to-Yahoo-suffix mapping (`BME`->`.MC`, `LSE`->`.L`, `XETR`->`.DE`, `TSX`->`.TO`, `EURONEXT`->`.PA`, etc.) explicitly specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, research.md §Decision 4]
- [x] CHK007 Are the Web Dashboard navigation tab requirements (`Darwinex MT5` vs `Yahoo Finance`) and the removal of `StrategySidebar` consistent between `spec.md` and `plan.md`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-007]

## Edge Case & Non-Functional Coverage

- [x] CHK008 Does the specification define behavior when a tracked instrument (such as an ETF, index, or FX pair) has no valuation or quarterly earnings records? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK009 Is non-finite float sanitization (`NaN`/`Inf` -> `null`) specified for both SQLite persistence and JSON responses? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, data-model.md §2]
- [x] CHK010 Are concurrency conflict rules (`409 Conflict` when a batch sync is already `IN_PROGRESS`) and SQLite WAL lock retry requirements specified? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Constitution §V]

## Measurability & Acceptance Criteria

- [x] CHK011 Are migration volume (`1,011` tickers, `1,313,580` prices, `12,374` valuations) and latency targets (`<60s` migration, `<500ms` local queries) quantified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-002]
- [x] CHK012 Are offline CI testability requirements (injectable ticker factory and mockable DB connections) defined? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, Constitution §IV]

## Notes

- All 12/12 requirements-quality criteria reviewed and satisfied (`[x]`).
